36576-the-student-life-of-germany.title: The Student Life Of Germany
36576-the-student-life-of-germany.creator: Unknown
36576-the-student-life-of-germany.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. now know I what thou undertook when thou held thy annual, solitary, intercalary day! Thou too hadst thy companions in the days of thy youth, and the water stood in thy gray eyelashes when thou marked one in thy stambook as entombed."

4304-our-friend-the-charlatan.title: Our Friend the Charlatan
4304-our-friend-the-charlatan.creator: George Gissing
4304-our-friend-the-charlatan.description: A book by George Gissing. Nearer causes of disquiet were not lacking to him. For several years the income of his living had steadily decreased; his glebe, upon which he chiefly depended, fell more and more under the influence of agricultural depression, and at present he found himself, if not seriously embarrassed, likely to be so in a very short time.

arxiv-2105-09902.title: Pulse-level noisy quantum circuits with QuTiP
arxiv-2105-09902.creator: Boxi Li, Shahnawaz Ahmed, Sidhant Saraogi, Neill Lambert, Franco Nori, Alexander Pitchford, Nathan Shammah
arxiv-2105-09902.description: Abstract The study of the impact of noise on quantum circuits is especially relevant to guide the progress of Noisy Intermediate-Scale Quantum (NISQ) computing. In this paper, we address the pulse-level simulation of noisy quantum circuits with the Quantum Toolbox in Python (QuTiP). We introduce new tools in qutip-qip , QuTiP’s quantum information processing package.

arxiv-2111-10037.title: Explaining GNN over Evolving Graphs using Information Flow
arxiv-2111-10037.creator: Yazheng Liu, Xi Zhang, Sihong Xie
arxiv-2111-10037.description: Abstract Graphs are ubiquitous in many applications, such as social networks, knowledge graphs, smart grids, etc.. Graph neural networks (GNN) are the current state-of-the-art for these applications, and yet remain obscure to humans. Explaining the GNN predictions can add transparency.

arxiv-2201-03293.title: Impact of NOMA and CoMP Implementation Order on the Performance of Ultra-Dense Networks
arxiv-2201-03293.creator: Akhileswar Chowdary 1 , Garima Chopra 1 , Abhinav Kumar 1 , and Linga Reddy Cenkeramaddi 2
arxiv-2201-03293.description: Abstract Non-orthogonal multiple access (NOMA) is a promising multiple access technology to improve the throughput and spectral efficiency of the users for 5G and beyond cellular networks. Similarly, coordinated multi-point transmission and reception (CoMP) is an existing technology to improve the coverage of cell-edge users. Hence, NOMA along with CoMP can potentially enhance the throughput and coverage of the users.

arxiv-2208-11008.title: Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev model: Non-self-averaging properties of the energy spectrum
arxiv-2208-11008.creator: Richard Berkovits
arxiv-2208-11008.description: Abstract The short time (large energy) behavior of the Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev model (SYK) is one of the main motivation to the growing interest garnered by this model. True chaotic behavior sets in at the Thouless time, which can be extracted from the energy spectrum. In order to do so, it is necessary to unfold the spectrum, i.e.

arxiv-2209-13599.title: A characterization of polynomial time computable functions from the integers to the reals using discrete ordinary differential equations Thanks: This work has been partially supported by ANR Project ∂ I ​ F ​ F ​ E ​ R ​ E ​ N ​ C ​ E \partial IFFERENCE .
arxiv-2209-13599.creator: Manon Blanc, Olivier Bournez
arxiv-2209-13599.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Manon Blanc, Olivier Bournez. In a recent article, the class of functions from the integers to the integers computable in polynomial time has been characterized using discrete ordinary differential equations (ODE), also known as finite differences. Doing so, we pointed out the fundamental role of linear (discrete) ODEs and classical ODE tools such as changes of variables to capture computability and complexity measures, or as a tool for programming.

arxiv-2302-00948.title: Dynamical Mordell–Lang conjecture for totally inseparable liftings of Frobenius
arxiv-2302-00948.creator: She YANG
arxiv-2302-00948.description: Abstract We prove that if K K is a complete algebraically closed non-archimedian valuation field of positive characteristic and f f is an endomorphism of ℙ K N \mathbb{P}_{K}^{N} which is totally inseparable and behaves as the Frobenius on the special fiber, then f f satisfies the dynamical Mordell–Lang (DML) property. We also discuss some corollaries and generalizations.

arxiv-2303-14614.title: A Golden Decade of Polar Codes: From Basic Principle to 5G Applications
arxiv-2303-14614.creator: Kai Niu, Ping Zhang, Jincheng Dai, Zhongwei Si, Chao Dong \corinfo niukai@bupt.edu.cn
arxiv-2303-14614.description: Abstract After the pursuit of seventy years, the invention of polar codes indicates that we have found the first capacity-achieving coding with low complexity construction and decoding, which is the great breakthrough of the coding theory in the past two decades. In this survey, we retrospect the history of polar codes and summarize the advancement in the past ten years.

arxiv-2312-15541.title: Room temperature relaxometry of single nitrogen-vacancy centers in proximity to α \alpha -RuCl 3 nanoflakes
arxiv-2312-15541.creator: Jitender Kumar, Dan Yudilevich, Ariel Smooha, Inbar Zohar, Arnab K. Pariari, Rainer Stöhr, Andrej Denisenko, Markus Hücker, Amit Finkler
arxiv-2312-15541.description: Abstract Investigating spin and charge noise in strongly correlated electron systems is a valuable way to analyze their physical properties and unlock new phases of matter. In this context, nitrogen-vacancy (NV) center-based magnetometry has been proven to be a versatile sensor for various classes of magnetic materials in broad temperature and frequency ranges.

arxiv-2401-03721.title: Failure of Mott’s formula for the Thermopower in Carbon Nanotubes
arxiv-2401-03721.creator: A. V. Kavokin, M. E. Portnoi, A. A. Varlamov, Yuriy Yerin
arxiv-2401-03721.description: Abstract Well-known Mott’s formula links the thermoelectric power characterised by Seebeck coefficient to conductivity. We calculate analytically the thermoelectric current and Seebeck coefficient in one-dimensional systems and show that, while the prediction of Mott’s formula is valid for Dirac fermions, it is misleading for the carriers having a parabolic dispersion.

arxiv-2401-11656.title: Agent-Based Modeling of C. Difficile Spread in Hospitals: Assessing Contribution of High-Touch vs. Low-Touch Surfaces and Inoculations’ Containment Impact
arxiv-2401-11656.creator: Sina Abdidizaji, Ali Khodabandeh Yalabadi, Mehdi Yazdani-Jahromi, Ozlem Ozmen Garibay, Ivan Garibay
arxiv-2401-11656.description: Abstract Health issues and pandemics remain paramount concerns in the contemporary era. Clostridioides Difficile Infection (CDI) stands out as a critical healthcare-associated infection with global implications. Effectively understanding the mechanisms of infection dissemination within healthcare units and hospitals is imperative to implement targeted containment measures. In this study, we address the limitations of prior research by Sulyok et al.

arxiv-2403-16541.title: Effects of tensor spin polarization on the chiral restoration and deconfinement phase transitions
arxiv-2403-16541.creator: Yan-Ru Bao, Sheng-Qin Feng
arxiv-2403-16541.description: Abstract Abstract: Effects of tensor spin polarization (TSP) on the chiral restoration and deconfinement phase transitions are studied in Polyakov loop extended Nambu-Jona-Lasinio (PNJL) model. For chiral phase transition, the higher the polarized degree of quark-antiquark pairs under the strong magnetic field, the higher the phase transition temperature. The TSP corrects the position of the critical end point.

arxiv-2405-01499.title: Optical Manipulation of Spin States in Ultracold Magnetic Atoms via an Inner-Shell Hz Transition
arxiv-2405-01499.creator: F. Claude, L. Lafforgue, J. J. A. Houwman, M. J. Mark, F. Ferlaino
arxiv-2405-01499.description: Abstract Lanthanides, like erbium and dysprosium, have emerged as powerful platforms for quantum-gas research due to their diverse properties, including a significant large spin manifold in their absolute ground state. However, effectively exploiting the spin richness necessitates precise manipulation of spin populations, a challenge yet to be fully addressed in this class of atomic species.

arxiv-2409-06524.title: LHC beam monitoring via real-time hit reconstruction in the LHCb VELO pixel detector
arxiv-2409-06524.creator: Daniele Passaro 1,2, Giulio Cordova 2,3, Federico Lazzari 2,3, Elena Graverini 2,3,4, Micheal Morello 1,2 and Giovanni Punzi 2,3
arxiv-2409-06524.description: Abstract The increasing computing power and bandwidth of programmable digital devices opens new possibilities in the field of real-time processing of HEP data. The LHCb collaboration is exploiting these technology advancements in various ways to enhance its capability for complex data reconstruction in real time.

arxiv-2501-03016.title: Classification of LCD and self-dual codes over a finite non-unital local ring Thanks: * Corresponding author
arxiv-2501-03016.creator: Anup Kushwaha, Indibar Debnath, Om Prakash, Patrick Solé ∗
arxiv-2501-03016.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Anup Kushwaha, Indibar Debnath, Om Prakash, Patrick Solé ∗. This work explores LCD and self-dual codes over a noncommutative non-unital ring E p = ⟨ r , s | p r = p s = 0 , r 2 = r , s 2 = s , r s = r , s r = s ⟩ E_{p}=\langle r,s~|~pr=ps=0,~r^{2}=r,~s^{2}=s,~rs=r,~sr=s\rangle of order p 2 p^{2} where p p is a prime. Initially, we study the monomial equivalence of two free E p E_{p} -linear codes.

arxiv-2504-10439.title: Bayesian Analysis of Interpretable Aging across Thousands of Lithium-ion Battery Cycles
arxiv-2504-10439.creator: Marc D. Berliner, Minsu Kim, Xiao Cui, Vivek N. Lam, Patrick A. Asinger, Martin Z. Bazant, William C. Chueh, Richard D. Braatz
arxiv-2504-10439.description: Abstract The Doyle-Fuller-Newman (DFN) model is a common mechanistic model for lithium-ion batteries. The reaction rate constant and diffusivity within the DFN model are key parameters that directly affect the movement of lithium ions, thereby offering explanations for cell aging.

arxiv-2504-17045.title: Dynamic Superblock Pruning for Fast Learned Sparse Retrieval Conference: Proceedings of the 48th International ACM SIGIR Conference on Research and Development in Information Retrieval; July 13–18, 2025; Padua, Italy Proceedings of the 48th International ACM SIGIR Conference on Research and Developm
arxiv-2504-17045.creator: Parker Carlson, Wentai Xie, Shanxiu He, Tao Yang
arxiv-2504-17045.description: Abstract . This paper proposes superblock pruning (SP) during top- k k online document retrieval for learned sparse representations. SP structures the sparse index as a set of superblocks on a sequence of document blocks and conducts a superblock-level selection to decide if some superblocks can be pruned before visiting their child blocks.

arxiv-2505-20590.title: Scaling Law of Urban Individual Tour Behavior
arxiv-2505-20590.creator: Xu-Jie Lin, Yitao Yang, Wei-Peng Nie, Xiao-Yong Yan
arxiv-2505-20590.description: Abstract Analysing and modeling urban individual tour behavior are of great significance for a wide range of applications such as transportation management and urban planning. However, the urban tour length distribution has long been neglected in individual mobility models that can be found in recent literature.

arxiv-2505-24675.title: Trustworthy Provenance for Big Data Science: a Modular Architecture Leveraging Blockchain in Federated Settings
arxiv-2505-24675.creator: Nicola Giuseppe Marchioro, Yannis Velegrakis, Valentine Anantharaj, Ian Foster, Sandro Luigi Fiore
arxiv-2505-24675.description: Abstract Ensuring the trustworthiness and long-term verifiability of scientific data is a foundational challenge in the era of data-intensive, collaborative research. Provenance metadata plays a key role in this context, capturing the origin, transformation, and usage of research artifacts. However, existing solutions often fall short when applied to distributed, multi-institutional settings.

arxiv-2507-16126.title: TaxCalcBench: Evaluating Frontier Models on the Tax Calculation Task
arxiv-2507-16126.creator: Michael R. Bock, Kara Molisee, Zachary Ozer, Sumit Shah, Column Tax
arxiv-2507-16126.description: Abstract Can AI file your taxes? Not yet. Calculating US personal income taxes is a task that requires building an understanding of vast amounts of English text and using that knowledge to carefully compute results. We propose TaxCalcBench, a benchmark for determining models’ abilities to calculate personal income tax returns given all of the necessary information.

arxiv-2509-03481.title: PoolPy: Flexible Group Testing Design for Large-Scale Screening
arxiv-2509-03481.creator: Lorenzo Talamanca, Julian Trouillon
arxiv-2509-03481.description: Abstract In large screening campaigns, group testing can greatly reduce the number of tests needed when compared to testing each sample individually. However, choosing and applying an appropriate group testing method remains challenging due to the wide variety in design and performance across methods, and the lack of accessible tools.

arxiv-2601-10781.title: Future Optical Flow Prediction Improves Robot Control & Video Generation
arxiv-2601-10781.creator: Kanchana Ranasinghe, Honglu Zhou, Yu Fang, Luyu Yang, Le Xue, Ran Xu, Caiming Xiong, Silvio Savarese, Michael S Ryoo, Juan Carlos Niebles
arxiv-2601-10781.description: Abstract Future motion representations, such as optical flow, offer immense value for control and generative tasks. However, forecasting generalizable spatially dense motion representations remains a key challenge, and learning such forecasting from noisy, real-world data remains relatively unexplored. We introduce FOFPred, a novel language-conditioned optical flow forecasting model featuring a unified Vision-Language Model (VLM) and Diffusion architecture.

pmc-10536231.title: Wearable Device for Cumulative Chlorobenzene Detection and Accessible Mitigation Strategies
pmc-10536231.creator: Aryan Mago, Yeon-Suk Yang, Jae-Hyuck Shim, Aijaz Ahmad John
pmc-10536231.description: Chronic exposure to low concentrations of volatile organic compounds (VOCs), such as chlorobenzene, is not being monitored in industrializing countries, although VOC exposure is associated with carcinogenic, organ-toxic, and endocrine-disrupting effects. Current VOC-sensing technologies are inaccessible due to high cost, size, and maintenance or are ineffective due to poor sensitivity or reliability.

pmc-10574879.title: Quantitative Analysis of Seed Surface Tubercles in Silene Species
pmc-10574879.creator: José Luis Rodríguez-Lorenzo, José Javier Martín-Gómez, Ana Juan, Ángel Tocino, Emilio Cervantes, Daoquan Xiang, Teagen D Quilichini, Matthew Tucker
pmc-10574879.description: In the Caryophyllaceae, seed surfaces contain cell protrusions, of varying sizes and shapes, called tubercles. Tubercles have long been described in many species, but quantitative analyses with measurements of size and shape are lacking in the literature. Based on optical photography, the seeds of Silene were classified into four types: smooth, rugose, echinate and papillose.

pmc-10652081.title: Dichloromethane-Induced Poisoning from Acrylic Paint Cleaner — Shenzhen City, Guangdong Province, China, 2023
pmc-10652081.creator: Xiaojun Zheng, Yuan Zhuang, Dongmei Liang, Nan Wu, Tao Wei, Anhua Kang, Xiandong Zeng, Chuanwen Dai, Xiang Guo
pmc-10652081.description: What is already known about this topic?Dichloromethane (DCM) is a colorless and transparent organic solvent that commonly causes poisoning during occupational contact.What is added by this report?Unknown to teachers and students, they were utilizing an acrylic paint cleaner that contained DCM. At the time of the poisoning incident, the art room was occupied beyond its capacity with inadequate local ventilation.

pmc-10681922.title: LncBIRC3-OT promotes the malignant progression of glioma by interacting with RELA to upregulate stanniocalcin-1 expression
pmc-10681922.creator: Renjie Wang, Qi Li, Xiaolei Chu, Nan Li, Haiqian Liang, Feng He
pmc-10681922.description: Glioma is the most common malignant intracranial tumor, accounting for 80 % of all malignant brain tumors. Growing evidence suggests that lncRNAs are involved in the growth, angiogenesis, metastasis, and therapeutic resistance in a variety of tumors, including glioma. In this study, lncBIRC3-OT (NONHSAT159592.

pmc-11325980.title: A commentary on the article entitled ‘Progress in the surgical treatment of sacrococcygeal pilonidal sinus’
pmc-11325980.creator: Chu-Yun Xing, Ming-Yan Huang, Shi-Zhou Cheng
pmc-11325980.description: e screening. The aim of this study was to investigate issues related to the surgical treatment of sacrococcygeal pilonidal sinus (SPS), such as the selection of the optimal treatment plan for SPS, the necessity of abandoning the midline closure technique for the treatment of SPS, and the development of an individualized plan for patients.

pmc-11467370.title: Nanoengineering‐armed oncolytic viruses drive antitumor response: progress and challenges
pmc-11467370.creator: Yan Zhang, Xinyu Shi, Yifan Shen, Xiulin Dong, Ruiqing He, Guo Chen, Yan Zhang, Honghong Tan, Kun Zhang
pmc-11467370.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Oncolytic viruses (OVs) have emerged as a powerful tool in cancer therapy. Characterized with the unique abilities to selectively target and lyse tumor cells, OVs can expedite the induction of cell death, thereby facilitating effective tumor eradication. Nanoengineering‐derived OVs overcome traditional OV therapy limitations by enhancing the stability of viral circulation, and tumor targeting, promising improved clinical safety and efficacy and so on. This review provides a comprehensive analysis of the multifaceted mechanisms through which engineered OVs can suppress tumor progression.

pmc-11479539.title: Outcome of laparoscopic feeding jejunostomy, comparison of a pure laparoscopic technique with Witzel’s tunnel to open technique: a retrospective cohort study
pmc-11479539.creator: Sumet Komek, Sirikan Limpakan, Peticha Tanprasert, Bandhuphat Chakrabandhu
pmc-11479539.description: IntroductionObstructive upper GI cancer commonly uses feeding jejunostomy as a standard procedure. Surgeons implemented laparoscopic feeding jejunostomy via minimally invasive surgery, employing a variety of techniques. This study assessed the perioperative results, safety, and costs associated with laparoscopic versus open jejunostomy surgeries. We used only Witzel’s tunnel and standard laparoscopic instruments.

pmc-11538261.title: Tumor-immune hybrid cells evade the immune response and potentiate colorectal cancer metastasis through CTLA4
pmc-11538261.creator: Pariyada Tanjak, Amphun Chaiboonchoe, Thanawat Suwatthanarak, Kullanist Thanormjit, Onchira Acharayothin, Jantappapa Chanthercrob, Thammawat Parakonthun, Asada Methasate, Jared M Fischer, Melissa H Wong, Vitoon Chinswangwatanakul
pmc-11538261.description: Understanding the metastatic cascade is critical for the treatment and prevention of cancer-related death. Within a tumor, immune cells have the capacity to fuse with tumor cells to generate tumor-immune hybrid cells (THCs). THCs are hypothesized to be a subset of cancer cells with the capacity to enter circulation as circulating hybrid cells (CHC) and seed metastases.

pmc-11716911.title: Plasma GFAP use for population enrichment of clinical trials in preclinical Alzheimer’s disease
pmc-11716911.creator: Bruna Bellaver, Guilherme Povala, Pamela CL Ferreira, Guilherme Bauer‐Negrini, Firoza Z Lussier, Douglas Teixeira Leffa, João Pedro Ferrari‐Souza, Matheus Scarpatto Rodrigues, Carolina Soares, Markley Silva Oliveira, Nesrine Rahmouni, Cécile Tissot, Joseph Therriault, Stijn Servaes, Jenna Stevenson,
pmc-11716911.description: BackgroundWe showed that plasma GFAP (a proxy of astrocyte reactivity) abnormality is key to unleashing Aβ effects on tau phosphorylation in preclinical AD. This suggests that selecting cognitively unimpaired(CU) individuals with both high Aβ and plasma GFAP could offer an early time window in the disease, but with an increased risk of developing tau pathology.

pmc-12420567.title: Droplets Self-Draining on the Horizontal Slippery Surface for Real-Time Anti-/De-Icing
pmc-12420567.creator: Xiao Han, Xu Sun, Di Zhao, Mingjia Sun, Kesong Liu, Liping Heng, Lei Jiang
pmc-12420567.description: Highlights Self-draining slippery surface with light-thermal-electric synergy were fabricated to auto anti/de-icing even on horizontal devices.The synergy of photothermal conversion and thermoelectric coupling enables the ice melting, and self-draining of thawy droplets at the same time, avoiding the risk of re-freezing.
